Deloitte projects India's GDP growth in the range of 6.7%-6.9% for FY2025-26 and 6.5%-6.9% for FY2026-27 , supported by resilient domestic consumption, tax reforms, GST rationalisation, supportive monetary policy and improving business confidence.
